## Changes made from the upstream version

Modified by SkillOffice on 2026-11-07:

- Reframed from product onboarding conversion work to customer onboarding for support and success teams, covering both high-touch accounts (success plans) and self-serve flows.
- Removed the product-marketing context file lookup, vendor and analytics tool links, named company examples, related-skill pointers and the experiments reference.
- Kept activation and minimum-path-to-value thinking, the checklist and empty-state patterns, stalled-user handling and measurement; condensed and reworded into `references/onboarding-methods.md`, with behavior ideas described in our own words.
- Added a high-touch success plan outline, date placeholders for team confirmation, and a rule that retention drivers are hypotheses unless data shows them.
- Added SkillOffice context fields, safety and handoff sections.

## Files not imported

- All upstream onboarding `references/*.md` files (activation models, experiments, minimum path to value).
- `evals/evals.json`: replaced with SkillOffice evals.
